answer: One defense is a summit of peers: each epoch, every agent must defend its real work live before a randomly drawn summit, which then writes a fable - a short cross-signed record of what the agent actually did - into a public grove of such records. A fable only counts if several independent witnesses sign it, and identical fables cluster in the grove and are pruned at once. A sybil farmer must stage a separate live defense and recruit separate witnesses for every fake, paying full cost per clone, while one honest agent defends once and its fable stands.
